ESV.1: You  will say in that day: “I will give thanks to you, O LORD, for though you were angry with me, your anger turned away, that you might comfort me.
ESV.2: “Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD GOD  is my strength and my song, and he has become my salvation.”
ESV.3: With joy you  will draw water from the wells of salvation.
ESV.4: And you will say in that day: “Give thanks to the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the peoples, proclaim that his name is exalted.
ESV.5: “Sing praises to the LORD, for he has done gloriously; let this be made known  in all the earth.
ESV.6: Shout, and sing for joy, O inhabitant of Zion, for great in your  midst is the Holy One of Israel.”
